# Synthetic invoice fixtures

All names and invoice identifiers are synthetic; **not valid tax invoices**. No real invoices, companies, taxpayer IDs or personal information.

- text-invoice.pdf: embedded English text, PDF extraction gate.
- scan-invoice.png / .jpg: slightly rotated raster reproduction, only pixels; actual Tesseract invoked by real tests.
- scan-invoice.pdf: image-only PDF, no embedded text, PDF render + actual OCR gate.
- scan-chinese.png: simplified Chinese raster reproduction, tessdata_fast chi_sim+eng gate.

Generated by scripts/generate_invoice_fixtures.py with bundled reportlab/Pillow. No expected results hidden in image metadata. These test scans are synthetic, not photographs of real issued invoices. The engine must read pixels; fixture values are never returned by runtime code.
